name: @yokira404/dsh-git-guard
description: Two switches at the right of the Session header. The left one stops writes to your local git repository (git add, git commit); the right one stops uploads to a remote (git push, git remote, gh). Both start on, and switching a guard on never releases the other. The block happens before a command runs.
